member.name: T:Bezoro.Chess.Progression.ChessTrainingProgressRecorder
member.summary: Opt-in binding from typed UCI events to durable local training progress.
member.remarks: Bind before play and set context before loading or starting a match. Historical position loads never award training Elo: their new UCI GameId cannot authenticate the identity of an earlier saved match. New live moves after an empty-history load are eligible. Undo and repeated terminal notifications retain the current GameId and cannot award twice. Changing context during a game invalidates that game. No engine objects or Unity calls are used. An on-demand data worker drains captured immutable records; failed writes remain queued with their original timestamps. Admission is bounded; overflow reports the immutable rejected record through CaptureRejected and retains a diagnostic until explicitly acknowledged. Dispose stops observation; DisposeAsync also drains. Hosts must await shutdown drainage and surface failures instead of abandoning pending writes.

member.name: E:Bezoro.Chess.Progression.ChessTrainingProgressRecorder.CaptureRejected
member.summary: Reports each rejected record on the terminal-event delivery thread, outside the recorder gate.
member.remarks: The host must retain each payload and pause new play or recover it in Sequence order after accepted predecessors drain. Notifications may execute concurrently. Every subscriber is attempted; failures surface through LastError after admission failure is acknowledged.

member.summary: Acknowledges that the host observed and retained rejected records through the supplied count.
member.remarks: Does not retry writes or award rejected matches. Returns false if a newer rejection arrived or there is no admission failure to acknowledge.

member.summary: Sets explicit match intent and actual configured opponent strength/perspective before a new session position or game.
member.remarks: A changed context invalidates the session's current logical game even when its events are still queued. Reapplying identical metadata is harmless.

member.name: M:Bezoro.Chess.Progression.ChessTrainingProgressRecorder.DrainAsync
member.summary: Waits for captured writes and reports any failure. Stop observing first when using it as a shutdown barrier.
member.remarks: This does not deliver callbacks still queued in the session's synchronization context. Let terminal events arrive before disposing when their results must be retained.

member.name: M:Bezoro.Chess.Progression.ChessTrainingProgressRecorder.RetryPendingAsync
member.summary: Retries retained failed writes without changing their match metadata, then drains. This also works after observation was disposed.

member.name: M:Bezoro.Chess.Progression.ChessTrainingProgressRecorder.Dispose
member.summary: Stops new event delivery. Already captured records continue draining and must still be awaited.

member.name: M:Bezoro.Chess.Progression.ChessTrainingProgressRecorder.DisposeAsync
member.summary: Stops observation and waits for all queued records, surfacing any storage failure.
